entities.summary: Stadium 974 is a football stadium in Ras Abu Aboud, Doha, Qatar, about 10 kilometres (6.2 mi) south-east of central Doha. Officially opened on 30 November 2021, Stadium 974 was the first planned temporary venue in FIFA World Cup history.
